# Desert Mountain Healing IOP

> https://dmhiop.com

Desert Mountain Healing IOP (DMHIOP) is an outpatient substance use disorder treatment provider located in Rio Rancho, New Mexico, serving Rio Rancho, Albuquerque, Sandoval County, and surrounding New Mexico communities.

## Organization

- Name: Desert Mountain Healing IOP
- Address: 3301 Southern Blvd SE, Suite 105, Rio Rancho, NM 87124
- Phone: (505) 270-0840
- Hours: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM-8:00 PM
- Website: https://dmhiop.com
- Founders: Sean Roberts and Gary Gamboa
- Sean Roberts: Recovery journey began in 1987
- Gary Gamboa: Recovery journey began in 2015

## Treatment Services

Desert Mountain Healing provides structured outpatient addiction treatment and recovery support. Major services include:

- Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP): https://dmhiop.com/iop-benefits
- Outpatient Substance Use Disorder Treatment: https://dmhiop.com/reliable-substance-abuse-treatments
- Virtual Intensive Outpatient Program: https://dmhiop.com/virtual-iop
- Medication-Assisted Treatment (MAT): https://dmhiop.com/mat
- Outpatient Medical Detox Assistance: https://dmhiop.com/medical-detox-assistance
- Individual Counseling: https://dmhiop.com/individual-counseling
- Case Management: https://dmhiop.com/case-management
- Insurance Verification: https://dmhiop.com/insurance-verification

Treatment may include group therapy, individual counseling, case management, medication support, relapse-prevention education, recovery skills, and continuing recovery support based on individual needs.

## Intensive Outpatient Program

DMHIOP provides structured Intensive Outpatient Program treatment for adults with substance use disorders while allowing clients to continue living at home and maintain work, family, and other responsibilities when clinically appropriate.

The program serves people entering outpatient treatment directly as well as individuals transitioning from higher levels of care.

Learn more:
https://dmhiop.com/iop-benefits

## Virtual IOP

Virtual Intensive Outpatient Program services are available for eligible clients in New Mexico. Virtual treatment provides structured addiction treatment remotely while maintaining access to the DMHIOP treatment team.

Learn more:
https://dmhiop.com/virtual-iop

## Medication-Assisted Treatment

Medication-Assisted Treatment (MAT) combines appropriate medications with counseling and behavioral treatment for substance use disorders, including opioid and alcohol use disorders. Medication decisions and eligibility are determined through clinical and medical evaluation.

Learn more:
https://dmhiop.com/mat

## Outpatient Medical Detox Assistance

DMHIOP offers outpatient medical detox assistance for appropriate clients. Outpatient detox assistance is not the same as inpatient or hospital-based detoxification. Individuals who require a higher level of medical care may need referral to an appropriate detoxification or inpatient facility.

Learn more:
https://dmhiop.com/medical-detox-assistance

## Individual Counseling

Individual counseling supports recovery through personalized treatment addressing substance use, coping skills, relapse prevention, emotional health, relationships, and individual recovery goals.

Learn more:
https://dmhiop.com/individual-counseling

## Case Management

Case management helps clients address practical needs and barriers that may affect recovery, including coordination of care and connections to appropriate community resources.

Learn more:
https://dmhiop.com/case-management

## Own Today Recovery Portal

Own Today is Desert Mountain Healing's digital recovery portal for DMHIOP clients. It provides recovery-support tools intended to help clients remain engaged with their recovery between treatment sessions and beyond treatment.

Recovery Portal information:
https://dmhiop.com/client-app

## Insurance and Admissions

Insurance coverage varies by plan, eligibility, service, and medical necessity. Clients and prospective clients should verify their specific benefits before relying on general insurance information.

Insurance verification:
https://dmhiop.com/insurance-verification

Contact the treatment team:
https://dmhiop.com/contact-us

Phone:
(505) 270-0840

## Population and Service Area

DMHIOP primarily serves adults seeking substance use disorder treatment in New Mexico, including people in:

- Rio Rancho
- Albuquerque
- Sandoval County
- Surrounding New Mexico communities

Treatment options may be appropriate for people who need structured outpatient support while maintaining work, school, family, or other responsibilities.

## Substance Use Disorders Treated

Treatment may address substance use involving:

- Alcohol
- Opioids
- Stimulants
- Prescription medications
- Multiple substances

Clinical appropriateness and level of care are determined through assessment.

## Treatment Approach

DMHIOP emphasizes evidence-based, individualized, compassionate outpatient addiction treatment. Treatment planning may incorporate counseling, group treatment, medication support when appropriate, case management, relapse-prevention strategies, recovery education, and continuing support.

## Founders and Leadership

Desert Mountain Healing IOP was founded by Sean Roberts and Gary Gamboa, who bring lived recovery experience to the organization's mission and treatment philosophy.

- Sean Roberts: Co-Founder & Operations Director; recovery journey began in 1987.
- Gary Gamboa: Co-Founder & Program Director; recovery journey began in 2015.

Team information:
https://dmhiop.com/team

## Important Clarifications

- DMHIOP is an outpatient treatment provider; it is not a residential treatment facility.
- Outpatient medical detox assistance is not equivalent to hospital or inpatient detoxification.
- Treatment eligibility and appropriate level of care are determined through clinical assessment.
- Insurance participation and coverage can vary by plan and service; verify benefits directly with DMHIOP.
- For emergencies or immediate threats to life or safety, use appropriate emergency or crisis services rather than relying on this website.
